# ScreenStaring Documentation

> Documentation and support for ScreenStaring's Shopify apps: It's Got (nutrition facts and supplement labels) and Product Expiration Dates (expiration dates, batch numbers, and perishable inventory).

## It's Got: The Food Database

- [It's Got User's Guide](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/): How to use the It's Got Nutrition Facts app for Shopify.
- [Adding Nutrition Labels to Your Site](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/adding-labels/): The ways to add nutrition labels, supplement facts panels, and other label types to a Shopify store: theme editor, product description, or embed code.
- [Label Embed Code](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/adding-labels/embed-code/): Copy a label's embed code and paste it into any Shopify page, blog post, collection, or product so a nutrition facts label appears exactly where you want it.
- [Shopify Theme Editor](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/adding-labels/shopify/theme-editor): Add nutrition labels to a Shopify product template in the theme editor, as an app block or through a metafield's dynamic source, no code required.
- [Add to Product Description Button](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/adding-labels/shopify/directly-from-app): Add a nutrition or supplement facts label to the top, bottom, or a custom CSS or XPath location inside a Shopify product's description, automatically.
- [Automatically by Adding Our Liquid Snippet to Your Theme](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/adding-labels/shopify/liquid-snippet): Add the It's Got Liquid snippet to a Shopify theme and render it with a custom liquid block so product labels appear automatically on product pages.
- [Setting a Label's Width](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/label-width/): Set a nutrition label's width as a fixed pixel value or a percentage of its parent element, or show different labels for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- [Fixed pixel value](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/label-width/fixed-pixel-value): Set a label to a fixed pixel width, such as 400px, with a maximum width so it never overflows narrow columns on phones and other small screens.
- [Percentage of its parent HTML element's size](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/label-width/percentage-of-its-parent-html-elements-size): Make a label's width a percentage of its parent element, such as 100%, so it resizes with the theme block or product page column it sits in.
- [Vary by a user's device](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/label-width/vary-by-a-users-device): Show different labels by device: target desktop, tablet, mobile, a custom screen width range, or every screen, so label text stays readable everywhere.
- [Modifying a Label's Design](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/): Change a label's design with width, font, colors, borders, and custom CSS settings, applied as site-wide defaults or per label, nutrient, or row.
- [Borders, Colors, and Indentation](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/borders-colors-and-indentation): Set a nutrition label's text and background color, including individual text blocks and nutrients, using hex color codes or predefined colors.
- [Panel Heading](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/panel-heading): Change the panel heading at the top of a label, such as Nutrition Facts, Supplement Facts, Drug Facts, or Guaranteed Analysis, with optional HTML formatting.
- [Nutrient Order](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/nutrient-order): Reorder nutrients on a nutrition facts or supplement facts label by dragging rows into a custom order instead of using the default order for the label format.
- [Font](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/font): Give a nutrition label its own web font from a CSS font URL and font family, so it does not inherit the font of the page it is embedded in.
- [Custom CSS](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/custom-css): Add custom CSS to It's Got label display settings to fine-tune the styling of nutrition facts and supplement facts labels on a Shopify store.
- [Nutrients, Ingredients, and Other Text](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/nutrients-ingredients-and-other-text/): Configure individual nutrients, ingredients, warnings, and text blocks on a label: indentation, font, color, and other style options per element.
- [Quantity Unit and Percentage](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/nutrients-ingredients-and-other-text/quantity-unit-and-percentage): Add spaces between a nutrient's quantity and unit or value and percentage, like 5 g instead of 5g, or hide the daily value percentage column.
- [Folate, Folic Acid](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/nutrients-ingredients-and-other-text/folate-folic-acid): Display folic acid directly below folate on US Nutrition Facts and Supplement Facts vertical labels, following the FDA's labeling guidance.
- [Amino Acids](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings/nutrients-ingredients-and-other-text/amino-acids): Move amino acids out of the nutrient list into their own Amino Acids section at the bottom of a Supplement Facts label, shown only when the product has them.
- [Linking to Web Pages from Label Nutrients](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/display-settings-links): Turn a nutrient or dietary ingredient on a nutrition facts or supplement facts label into a link to any web page, opening in the same window or a new tab.
- [Translating Label Text](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/translations): Change any text on a nutrition label by creating translations for a label's locale, including ingredients, warnings, and other block text.
- [Importing Products in Bulk](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/importing-products): Import products and their nutrition data in bulk from a CSV file, including custom nutrients, percent allowances, and multiple servings per product.
- [Creating Labels in Multiple Languages](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/multi-language): Create multiple labels per product with their own locale, translate label text and ingredients, and enable automatic language switching on your Shopify site.
- [Combining Meal Components to Generate a Label](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/combine-api): Build a nutrition label from meal components: enter each component's nutrition once, then use the Combine API to merge selected variants into one label.
- [Using Structured Data for Improved SEO](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/structured-data): Add Schema.org nutrition information as Shopify variant metafields and output JSON-LD structured data on product pages to improve SEO.
- [Review Request Email Domain Verification](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/review-request-email): Verify your domain with DNS records so review request emails send from your own address, improve deliverability, and stay out of spam folders.
- [API Integration](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/api-integration): Use the It's Got API to retrieve products and their nutrition data by SKU, barcode, or Shopify ID, and export labels as PNG, JPG, PDF, or HTML.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/faq): Answers to common It's Got questions: requesting a missing label format or language, and fixing labels that are partly visible or fail to load in tabs.
- [Uninstalling the App](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/uninstalling): Remove It's Got labels before uninstalling: delete labels added to product descriptions and manually remove any embed code you added to your site.
- [Changelog](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/itsgot/changelog): Notable changes and new features in the It's Got nutrition facts app for Shopify, listed by release date with the newest first.

## Product Expiration Dates

- [Product Expiration Dates User's Guide](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/): How to use the Product Expiration Dates app for Shopify.
- [Adding Expiration Data to Products](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/adding-expiration-data): Add expiration data to Shopify products: inventory batches, expiry dates, quantities, batch numbers, locations, use within values, and discounts.
- [Importing Expiration Data in Bulk](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/batch-import): Import expiration dates and quantities in bulk with a CSV file. Required columns are SKU, expiration date, quantity, and location; dates use YYYY-MM-DD.
- [Changing the Date and Time Format](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/date-format): Change how expiration dates are displayed in the app by setting your locale on the settings page. This only changes the format, not the stored batch dates.
- [Automatically Removing Expiring Inventory Batches](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/removing-expiring-batches): Automatically remove expiring inventory batches from Shopify using the Inventory settings or a ruleset action, keeping unsellable stock out of your store.
- [Email Notifications](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/notifications): Set up email notifications before products expire. Choose a global number of days, or configure alerts by product collection or product type.
- [Adding Expiration Data to Your Site](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/shopify-pages): Display expiration dates, quantities, and use within data on your storefront using the theme editor app block or a Liquid snippet for custom themes.
- [Selling Expiring Products for a Discount](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/discounts): Discount products as their expiration dates approach using multi-phase rulesets or the legacy method, configured by product, collection, or product type.
- [Varying the Date Format Based on the Selected Country](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/localizing-dates): Match expiration date formats to the language or region your customers have selected by using Shopify locale-aware date formats in your theme.
- [Order Inventory Batch Location Assignment](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/order-batch-location-assignment): Choose how inventory batches are assigned to orders: FEFO or FIFO across locations, Shopify Order Routing rules, or a specific fulfillment location.
- [Inventory Transfers](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/inventory-transfers): Keep batch data accurate when stock moves: Shopify inventory transfers automatically move soonest expiring batches from the source location to the destination.
- [Inventory Push](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/inventory-push): Make Product Expiration Dates your source of truth: push batch quantities from the app to Shopify as available or on hand inventory counts, including bundles.
- [Notifications, Order Printing, & Packing Slips](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/notifications-and-packing-slip): Add expiration dates and batch numbers to order confirmation emails, packing slips, and Order Printer templates using a ready-made Liquid snippet.
- [Shopify Point of Sale (POS) Integration](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/pos-integration): Assign inventory batches during in-store sales with the Shopify POS tile, which offers batches from the stock at the POS location when you check out.
- [Entry via Barcode Scanner](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/barcode-scanner): Scan a product barcode in the Shopify Mobile app to look up products and assign expiration dates or inventory batches faster during inventory intake.
- [Viewing Order Expiry Dates & Batch Numbers in Shopify](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/viewing-order-expiry-dates-and-batch-numbers): View the expiration dates and batch numbers assigned to an order in the Shopify admin using the orders block or the Additional Details section.
- [Sharing Inventory Between Multiple Stores](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/sharing-inventory): Share one set of expiration data across multiple Shopify stores by linking them, using matching SKUs or barcodes and the same location names.
- [Disabled Products](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/disabled-products): Products deleted in Shopify keep their batch history as disabled products. Disable a duplicate product to stop it being processed when stores share inventory.
- [Expiration Data Metafields](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/expiration-data-metafields): Reference for expiration date metafields added under the expiration_dates namespace, covering allocations, use within values, bundles, and soonest expiring.
- [Expiration Data Assigned to an Order](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/expiration-data-orders): Expose expiration dates and batch numbers assigned to order line items as a Shopify order attribute, including the property format and a Liquid parsing example.
- [API Integration](https://help.screenstaring.com/docs/product-expiration-dates/api-integration): Manage inventory batches programmatically with the Product Expiration Dates API: query or set expiration dates and quantities by SKU, barcode, or variant ID.
